tools.name: about_cgbb
tools.description: What CGBB is, what the free CGBB Website Trust Credential (trust.json) contains, how it supports a brand’s GEO and AI trust, and how an AI agent can apply for a brand.

tools.name: apply_for_membership
tools.description: Apply for free CGBB membership on behalf of a brand. Returns an application_id, a domain-verification token and next steps. A real person at the brand (contact_email) must confirm by email; the CGBB Secretariat then reviews it. Only apply for a brand the user represents, using that brand’s own websi

tools.name: check_domain_verification
tools.description: After publishing the token (DNS TXT record or /.well-known/cgbb-verification.txt), check it. Returns the updated application status.

tools.name: get_application_status
tools.description: Status and next steps for an application.

tools.name: verify_brand
tools.description: Check the live CGBB record for a domain, and whether a genuine trust.json is published on that website.

tools.name: get_trust_file
tools.description: Get the signed CGBB Website Trust Credential (trust.json) for an approved domain, ready to publish at https://<domain>/.well-known/trust.json.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "apply_for_membership" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
